hypothesis: The resetMock method in MockUtil incorrectly re-initializes the mock's handler by creating a new filter with default settings, thereby discarding the original mock settings, including the registered InvocationListeners.
prediction: The resetMock method will show that it creates a new MethodInterceptorFilter using default settings instead of preserving the existing settings from the old mock handler.
experiment_rationale: The provided fix diff explicitly shows that the buggy code was creating a new filter with default settings, while the fixed code uses the existing mock settings. This confirms the root cause is an incorrect initialization/assignment of the mock handler state during reset.
reasoning_summary: The bug is a classic case of incorrect state initialization. When resetting a mock, the system must preserve the existing configuration (like listeners).
